mostWorthwhile.text: Following skin-cell division was most worthwhile: the planned sequences connect copied chromosomes, their separation and the division ring to two daughter cells and skin renewal.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the new skin cells to the body was comparatively repetitive: the inset shows replacement and shedding but adds little about the intervening process.

surprise.text: The low-oxygen cue linking a kidney signal to red-cell maturation in marrow was an interesting connection between organs.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the menu supplied compatible choices and the final bone-remodeling sequence offered only one combination at each step; I did not discover those relationships myself.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing for more connections between familiar cell biology and whole-body function, though the guided combinations left little room for meaningful choices in the later steps.
